# Manning LiveBook

> A comprehensive digital library of programming books covering Node.js, Go, C#, Ruby, MongoDB, and enterprise frameworks like Liferay.

Manning LiveBook provides interactive access to technical programming books spanning multiple languages and domains, from foundational concepts to advanced frameworks and databases. The collection emphasizes practical, hands-on learning through detailed chapters and reference materials.

## Key Topics

- Node.js
- Go
- MongoDB
- Liferay Portal
- API Development
- CRUD Operations
- JSON
- Service Builder
- Data Structures
- Portlet Development
- AJAX
- Structs & Interfaces
- Text Search
- Mobile Development
- Probabilistic Programming

## Backend & API Development

- [Lesson 27. Accessing Your API from Your Application](https://livebook.manning.com/book/get-programming-with-node-js/chapter-27): Node.js lesson on API access using AJAX and JSON responses
- [Part 1. First steps](https://livebook.manning.com/book/hapi-js-in-action/part-1): hapi.js framework introduction for Node.js API development
- [Lesson 21. Capstone: Adding CRUD Models to Confetti Cuisine](https://livebook.manning.com/book/get-programming-with-node-js/chapter-21): Node.js capstone project on CRUD operations and database models

## Programming Languages & Fundamentals

- [Part 1 Background and fundamentals](https://livebook.manning.com/book/go-in-practice-second-edition/part-1): Go programming fundamentals and foundational concepts
- [3 Structs, interfaces, and generics](https://livebook.manning.com/book/go-in-practice-second-edition/chapter-3): Go programming guide covering structs, interfaces, and generic types
- [Chapter 4. C# 4: Improving interoperability](https://livebook.manning.com/book/c-sharp-in-depth-fourth-edition/chapter-4): C# 4 features for interoperability, dynamic typing, and COM integration
- [Chapter 9. Collection and container objects](https://livebook.manning.com/book/the-well-grounded-rubyist/chapter-9): Ruby collections including arrays, hashes, and container data structures
- [Index](https://livebook.manning.com/book/go-in-action/index): Go programming language comprehensive index and reference

## Database & Data Management

- [Chapter 9. Text search](https://livebook.manning.com/book/mongodb-in-action-second-edition/chapter-9): MongoDB text search indexing, queries, and aggregation framework

## Enterprise Portal Development

- [Part 1. Working with Liferay and portlets](https://livebook.manning.com/book/liferay-in-action/part-1): Liferay portal development introduction with portlets and Plugins SDK
- [Part 2. Writing applications on Liferay's platform](https://livebook.manning.com/book/liferay-in-action/part-2): Liferay platform development with Service Builder and portlet architecture
- [Chapter 3. A data-driven portlet made easy](https://livebook.manning.com/book/liferay-in-action/chapter-3): Liferay Service Builder for data-driven portlets using DAO/DTO architecture
- [Appendix E. Liferay 6.1 Documents API](https://livebook.manning.com/book/liferay-in-action/appendix-e): Liferay 6.1 Documents API and Document Library reference

## Mobile & UI Development

- [About this Book](https://livebook.manning.com/book/sencha-touch-in-action/about-this-book): Introduction to Sencha Touch mobile development framework with HTML5
- [Chapter 6. Getting the user's attention](https://livebook.manning.com/book/sencha-touch-in-action/chapter-6): Sencha Touch UI components for overlays, modals, and message boxes

## Specialized Topics

- [Chapter 2. A quick Figaro tutorial](https://livebook.manning.com/book/practical-probabilistic-programming/chapter-2): Figaro probabilistic programming tutorial on model building and inference

## Optional

- [About the Cover Illustration](https://livebook.manning.com/book/mongodb-in-action-second-edition/about-the-cover-illustration): MongoDB book cover illustration and historical context
- [Acknowledgments](https://livebook.manning.com/book/deep-learning-with-r/acknowledgments): Deep Learning with R book credits and contributors
